# Workflow factory visual fixture

Run `node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --config mailmypdf/tests/fixtures/workflow-factory/vite.config.ts` from the repository root and open `http://127.0.0.1:4198/`. This renders the real Factory component with synthetic data. `?error=1` shows the failure state. No authentication, payment, mailing, or production data is used.
